title: DOE says changes in coal bidding rules apply to all, not just Semirara
summary: Department of Energy Secretary Sharon Garin on Monday said the changes in bidding rules for coal exploration projects apply equally to all bidders, following claims by Semirara Mining and Power Corp.…

blocks.text: Department of Energy Secretary Sharon Garin on Monday said the changes in bidding rules for coal exploration projects apply equally to all bidders, following claims by Semirara Mining and Power Corp. that the new conditions effectively prevent the company from participating in the bidding.
